For the best result, wear it as a tailored summer short as much as a swim short. Adjust it from the waistband, not the inner mesh, rinse it with fresh water after swimming, wash only when needed on a cold delicate cycle or by hand with mild detergent, and always air dry. It works especially well with a linen top or a Pima knit polo if you want it to feel more polished off the beach.
